reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: One nominal Fantasy candidate was inspected and rejected as same-sculpt proof. The published cover depicts a different pose with an outstretched horizontal blade, alternative thigh/leg armor silhouette and a hand-shaped base; source view 1 depicts a blade raised over the shoulder, standing figure and cracked-rock base. Source views 2–7 corroborate the source sculpt. Different sculpture from the only exact-name candidate, but absence of further alias/historical models is not proven.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Human review of geometry, props, pose and base with SHA-256 verified source images; dHash corroborates and never decides identity automatically.

decision.nextGate: Search additional published aliases/franchise and historical images read-only; never create a new model merely because the single literal candidate is visually different.
